title: Malicious code in ep_nxs75232 (npm)
description: The npm package ep_nxs75232 (version 1.0.0) contains malicious code that adds an undocumented, unauthenticated HTTP GET route (/Nx_75232/) to an Etherpad server. This route exposes sensitive host information including hostname, OS username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. The response is branded with attacker-specific banners, indicating its use for reconnaissance. Any remote client able to access the Etherpad instance can retrieve this information without authentication, potentially aiding further attacks.
